description: Import the Hurricane Katrina track data from ~/Documents/GeoGebra/data/katrina_track.csv into GeoGebra. The CSV contains Latitude and Longitude columns. Create a visualization of the storm's path by: (1) Creating points for each location (ensure X=Longitude, Y=Latitude), (2) Connecting these points in chronological order using a Polyline, and (3) Calculating the total distance of the track in kilometers. Assume 1 coordinate unit (degree) equals approx 111.32 km. Display the total distance on the screen using a text label (e.g., 'Total Distance: 2500 km'). Save the project as 'katrina_analysis.ggb' in ~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/.
